value.rationale: Sharp saturation rigidity is a motivated structural classification at the first non-series-parallel traffic topology exhibiting a factor-2 loss. The certificate R quantifies the welfare penalty avoided whenever center path is not tied or the relevant outer-exit/entrance/cross latencies change, and precisely characterizes why generic strictly increasing links cannot attain equality. This gives meaningful information beyond reproducing a known sharp example or reasserting the known coefficient.
